title: Leaderboard query: Progress leaderboard with difficulty multipliers
description: Create Convex query to fetch progress leaderboard. Score = (words_learned × multiplier) + (lines_completed × multiplier × 0.5). Uses language difficulty multipliers. Supports period filter and pagination.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Query accepts period (weekly/monthly/all-time), limit, offset args
Score calculation uses language difficulty multipliers
Only returns users with displayName set
Returns array with rank, displayName, score, topLanguage fields
